heading: Stocks Climb on US-China Optimism, Copper's AI Bppm
author: Bloomberg News Editorial
paragraphs:
Get a jump start on the US trading day with Dani Burger and Michael Ball on "Bloomberg Open Interest." Stocks rally and oil drops as investors look to diplomacy, with President Trump and China’s Xi Jinping preparing for a high-stakes White House meeting later this week.
Plus, inside Anthropic’s new AI safety partnership with Accenture, and Wall Street’s race to manage the risks and rewards of artificial intelligence.And legendary mining investor Robert Friedland joins us on why copper and rare earths are becoming the new front line in the US, China resource race. (Source: Bloomberg)
